checks.label: the temporary home sees the installed VSCodium server
theme, language-server and webview extensions installed from Open VSX
the panel shows VS Code in a frame on vscode.tauri.localhost
the real VS Code workbench renders inside the Orkestr window (explorer shows the project)
the project folder is open in the workbench
the project opens trusted (no Restricted Mode), so every extension can run
Orkestr's theme colors reach the workbench (--vscode-sideBar-background = --ok-color-bg)
the YAML extension's language server reports diagnostics in the open file
vscode.openFile (Open in VS Code) shows the file in the embedded workbench
the Claude Code extension's webview runs inside the embedded workbench (webview host + service worker, extension document loaded, theme passed)
extension catalog lists the installed extensions; bridge connected
the Dracula theme extension applies (workbench repainted)
Ctrl+Alt+K inside the embedded VS Code opens Orkestr's command palette
the Extensions tab lists the installed extensions with their icons
disable + Restart VS Code moves the extension out; it is reported disabled
the VS Code panel works detached into its own Orkestr window
